correctness.rationale: Every abstract endomorphism sends the additive Sylow p-subgroup into itself, inducing an additive map T there and a power map h on the cyclic quotient. From conjugation T(ab)=h(a)T(b), so if T is nonzero then T(1)≠0 and T(a)=h(a)T(1) for a≠0. This gives injectivity on the kernel and quotient, hence an automorphism, of which only the identity is idempotent. If T=0, the complement cocycle satisfies (1−h(a))c(b)=(1−h(b))c(a); when h is nontrivial this forces a unique scalar parameter u, and trivial h gives the zero map by coprimality. Substitution multiplies the two quotient exponents and retains the outer map's parameter; idempotent exponents are exactly CRT zero/one choices. The image of each proper nonzero map is the corresponding cyclic subgroup conjugated by translation by u. Intersecting supports therefore commute only for equal labels, while disjoint supports always commute. The degree comes from 2^k−2 same-layer and (q−1)(2^(k−s)−1) cross-layer neighbors. Distinct full supports in different layers have no common neighbor, while disjoint singletons provide paths of length at most three when k≥2. Layers are cliques of maximum size; support coloring is proper, and a maximum clique needs a full support and so cannot cross layers. A fixed support gives an independent set of size q, the upper bound from the layering. Inclusion-exclusion gives 3^k−2^(k+1)+1 ordered disjoint nonempty support pairs and 4^k−3^k intersecting pairs; weighting them by q² and q and including the two universal vertices gives the stated count, including 235 at q=7. When k=1 there are no cross-layer edges and each layer has one vertex; q=2 reduces to C₂. The frozen finite verifier was inspected, not executed.

The dicyclic record gives a diameter-three transition and CRT labels as well, but dimensions, label fibers, and commutation constraints differ: the number of labels depends on the support there, unlike the uniform q here.

value.rationale: The natural graph would be valuable if its joint structure remained unaccounted for, but the precise band and graph mechanisms in the prime-kernel comparison already force every stated kind of graph invariant. In the nonprime extension, the scalar transitivity argument eliminates the extra endomorphism possibilities: all extra automorphisms fail idempotence and every other map still factors through the same cyclic quotient and scalar cocycle. After that reduction the counts and sharp diameter proof are identical, with only the number of interchangeable translation labels changed. Thus the distinct scope extension supplies no new graph mechanism or nonroutine invariant calculation. This value judgment rests on the exact monoid comparison and the mathematical reduction, not on unsuccessful retrieval of the general endomorphism citation. No distinct surviving result is proposed as a repair.
